SIHF Skater box score of one game, both sides, with ice time and faceoffs

Source: R/sihf.R
sihf_game_player_stats.Rd

Skater box score of one game, both sides, with ice time and faceoffs.

Reads the Swiss Ice Hockey Federation statistics API (data.sihf.ch, keyless JSON). SIHF keys a season by its END year (2026 = 2025-26). An unknown season, league_id or phase_id is never an error upstream (SIHF silently answers another one), so every table answer is checked against the body's own filter echo and refused when it differs. Every request is spaced at least one second from the last one to the host.

Usage

sihf_game_player_stats(game_id, language = "en")

Arguments

game_id

Required. SIHF game id (game_id in sihf_results), e.g. 20261105000325.

language

Response language. Only part of the body is translated: status, position and penalty names stay German.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble with 26 columns. A zero-row tibble with these columns when the payload holds no rows.

col_nametypedescription
game_idnumericSIHF game id (numeric join key; the details link of sihf_results, the searchQuery of the game wrappers).
team_sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: "home" or "away".
team_idintegerSIHF team id of the row's side.
team_namecharacterTeam name of the row's side.
player_numberintegerJersey number worn in this game.
playercharacterPlayer name as SIHF prints it, last name first (e.g., "Dahlbeck Klas").
player_positioncharacterPosition, German whatever the language (e.g., "Verteidiger").
goalsintegerGoals scored by the player.
assistsintegerAssists (primary + secondary).
assists1integerPrimary assists.
assists2integerSecondary assists.
pointsintegerPoints (goals + assists).
pim_totalintegerPenalty minutes.
plus_minusintegerPlus-minus: even-strength and shorthanded goals for, minus against, while on ice.
shots_on_goalintegerShots on goal taken by the player.
sog_missedintegerShots that missed the net.
sog_postintegerShots off the post or crossbar.
blockingsintegerOpponent shots blocked by the player.
faceoffs_wonintegerFaceoffs won by the player.
faceoffs_lostintegerFaceoffs lost by the player.
faceoffs_percentnumericFaceoff win percentage, 0-100; null with no faceoffs.
time_on_icecharacterIce time, "mm:ss".
time_on_ice_ppcharacterPower-play ice time, "mm:ss".
time_on_ice_pkcharacterPenalty-kill ice time, "mm:ss".
row_typecharacter"data" per player, "total" for the side's total row.
player_idintegerSIHF licence number of the player (integer join key), resolved from the game's roster.

Errors

  • fastRhockey_no_data: SIHF answered 404 (unknown game), or ignored a requested season, league or phase and served another one.

  • fastRhockey_bad_request: SIHF answered 400 / 422, or an argument is invalid.

  • fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, an empty or unreadable body, a stub or redirect body, a table without its filter echo, a truncated table, or a gameoverview body for another game.
